singular_entrypoint.rule: All agents start at AI_FRONT_DOOR.md, then follow the required read order and task-specific branches.
singular_entrypoint.competing_entrypoints_policy: Mailboxes, generated reports, registries, and the library card catalog are routed branches, not alternate start-here surfaces.

entrypoint_policy.start_rule: Open AI_FRONT_DOOR.md first for DAD work, then use this registry for current navigation version and freshness.
entrypoint_policy.memory_rule: Do not rely on memory of remembered TOC structure; compare current navigation_version, updated_at, recent_changes, and branch_map before using old mental routes.
entrypoint_policy.branch_rule: Use AI_TABLE_OF_CONTENTS.md for semantic routing, MACHINE_NAVIGATION_MANIFEST.json for tool routing, and branch_map entries for freshness hints.
entrypoint_policy.mailbox_rule: Mail is a candidate suggestion transport surface; it does not replace the front door or local source authority.

branch_depth_policy.rule: Default navigation should be front door -> TOC or manifest or navigation registry -> task-relevant surface.
branch_depth_policy.anti_bloat_rule: Do not add date/version columns to every TOC row; add material freshness here and keep TOC rows descriptive.

freshness_policy.version_check: Agents and enrolled repos should record the navigation_version they used and re-read recent_changes when the version differs.
freshness_policy.date_policy: Material navigation changes update updated_at and either branch_map.last_material_change_at or recent_changes; minor typo fixes do not need a new branch row.
freshness_policy.stale_memory_action: If the current navigation_version or updated_at differs from memory, inspect recent_changes first, then read only the affected branch rows.
freshness_policy.toc_row_policy: AI_TABLE_OF_CONTENTS.md remains a routing map with path, role, tags, and use-when triggers; this registry carries freshness metadata.

change_classes.meaning: A front door, TOC, manifest, or navigation rule changed.
change_classes.agent_action: Re-read the front door, this registry, and affected TOC rows before material work.

change_classes.meaning: DAD needs, offerings, assets, skills, harnesses, or language guidance changed.
change_classes.agent_action: Re-run preflight or DAD matching before choosing assets, harnesses, or coding tactics.

change_classes.meaning: Mail, outbox, inbox, digest, provenance, release, or triage behavior changed.
change_classes.agent_action: Use the current mail docs and schema before composing, collecting, routing, delivering, or reviewing mail.

change_classes.meaning: Lessons, exception capture, hard-issue lookup, or postflight feedback changed.
change_classes.agent_action: Search current learning and exception surfaces before debugging hard issues or recording reusable lessons.

change_classes.meaning: Generated candidate evidence changed without becoming source truth.
change_classes.agent_action: Treat the report as candidate evidence and check source methodology, hashes, and freshness before relying on it.

branch_map.role: Singular human- and AI-readable start point for DAD work.
branch_map.use_when: Always start here before material work.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Read the navigation freshness section before relying on remembered DAD paths.

branch_map.role: Machine-readable navigation version, branch freshness, and recent material changes.
branch_map.use_when: You need to know what changed since the last DAD visit without bloating the TOC.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Compare navigation_version and updated_at to any cached or repo-local last-seen value.

branch_map.role: Semantic branching map with path, role, tags, and use-when triggers.
branch_map.use_when: You know the task class and need the smallest matching branch.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use the TOC for routing meaning; use this registry for freshness.

branch_map.role: Machine-readable start files, registries, generated surfaces, and validation commands.
branch_map.use_when: A tool or agent needs deterministic paths rather than prose routing.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Manifest freshness mirrors the navigation registry version for DAD entrypoint changes.

branch_map.role: Ordered proof ladder for DAD local deployment, all-repo inventory, mail trials, exception capture, Rust production slice, catalog routes, and reviewed enrollment waves.
branch_map.use_when: You are continuing DAD deployment/all-repo verification or deciding which phase must happen next.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Machine evidence does not satisfy human gates; check roadmap/gate-evidence.json before marking phases complete.

branch_map.role: Local bootstrap, hub locator, stable invocation, doctor scopes, and unavailable-hub policy.
branch_map.use_when: DAD needs to be callable from a non-DAD repo without manual PYTHONPATH knowledge.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use deployment-scope doctor for hub/install proof; operational-scope doctor remains the stricter generated-surface readiness check.

branch_map.role: Rich card catalog of DAD assets, skills, harnesses, architecture refs, maps, workflows, and known upgrades.
branch_map.use_when: A repo or agent needs to match context to DAD offerings, use now, save for future, or watch an upgrade channel.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use with dad-usefulness methodology; catalog changes may require a new context pack.

branch_map.role: DAD request list for what repos should send back through candidate mail.
branch_map.use_when: A repo needs to decide whether a lesson, asset, harness result, exception, or governance drift should be sent to DAD.
branch_map.freshness_hint: A needs change can alter outbox emission expectations; check recent_changes before assuming old packet rules.

branch_map.role: First-stop route for understanding DAD's Rust system before reading adoption plans or implementation code.
branch_map.use_when: Another repo or AI asks where to look to understand DAD's Rust system.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Read in order: starter-pack README, Rust adoption plan, then Rust code and Python bridge directories.

branch_map.role: Rust rollout lesson-capture protocol for append-only ledger rows, schema expectations, summary regeneration, and repo feedback packets.
branch_map.use_when: A repo needs to send, process, validate, or summarize Rust rollout lessons during Rust deployment or mail storms.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use this protocol before accepting ad hoc Rust lesson blobs; validate the ledger rows and regenerate summaries after appends.

branch_map.role: Decision model for choosing harnesses, advisory reporting, warnings, or deterministic enforcement.
branch_map.use_when: A repo or agent discovers an issue and must decide whether it belongs in a harness, subharness, report, warning, validator, CI gate, or hard stop.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Start harness-first for learning and ambiguity; enforce only stable, objective, high-risk boundaries.

branch_map.role: Claude-readable packet guidance for integration and implementation issue patterns that may have architectural root causes.
branch_map.use_when: Repeated integration failures, implementation drift, boundary mismatch, ownership ambiguity, or review findings suggest architecture rather than a single local bug.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use safe metadata packets for Claude root-cause review; never raw logs, private rows, copied source, or hidden reasoning.

branch_map.role: Candidate design for lesson lifecycle review overlays, review clocks, upgrades, downgrades, supersession, and archive status.
branch_map.use_when: A repo or agent needs to decide whether an old lesson is still useful, stale, harmful, superseded, or ready for promotion review.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Lifecycle metadata is an overlay on immutable lessons; do not rewrite raw lesson records or enforce this before reviewed examples exist.

branch_map.role: Governed DAD mail hub and repo-local inbox/outbox mirror design.
branch_map.use_when: You compose, collect, route, deliver, digest, review, or explain DAD mail.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Mail remains candidate-only and repo-facing; event pipeline rows provide explicit response-state candidate metadata.

branch_map.role: Local-first event/data pipeline contract beneath mail, including repo event outboxes, central event logs, response-state rows, quarantine, and Rust leaf-check boundaries.
branch_map.use_when: You need repo responses, asset-use feedback, exception/fix outcomes, or DAD notice adoption to be explicit instead of inferred from mail presence.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Events are candidate metadata only; Rust may shadow-check structure later, but Python/DAD retains policy authority.

branch_map.role: Operator runbook for concurrent repo mail storms, wrong-box inbox writes, source-outbox duplicate retries, Rust rollout staging, and dirty-worktree separation.
branch_map.use_when: Many repos or branches are writing DAD mail, Rust rollout lessons, or learning-loop packets and the DAD tree looks very dirty.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Use mail doctor safe_to_collect/safe_to_route/safe_to_deliver instead of treating git worktree dirt as mailbox corruption.

branch_map.role: Reusable harness and eval cases for enrollment/mail write boundaries, dirty-spool gates, source-outbox retry storms, cross-source provenance conflicts, Rust rollout snapshot churn, and worktree-dirt separation.
branch_map.use_when: You need to test or red-team DAD mail/enrollment behavior during concurrent repo mail, Rust rollout, or very dirty worktree states.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Run or inspect this harness when mail doctor behavior changes; retry duplicates are observations, but reviewed cross-source identity conflicts block.

branch_map.role: DAD 9-layer address model for compact asset, workflow, exception, and learning coordinates.
branch_map.use_when: You need compact context or graph-compatible coordinates without storing bulky workflow text inline.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Layer-model changes are semantic; compare registry version before using old address assumptions.

branch_map.role: Cross-repo exceptions lake, fix-outcome ledger, and exception-to-learning compiler plan.
branch_map.use_when: You capture or learn from failures, bypasses, review findings, fix outcomes, or missed DAD mail patterns.
branch_map.freshness_hint: Exception capture patterns change quickly; inspect recent changes before judging whether a repo should have emitted mail.

recent_changes.summary: Added the first local-first event pipeline slice beneath mail: repo event outboxes, central event log, response-state rows, malformed/unsafe quarantine, report output, and explicit Rust leaf-check boundaries.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use events for explicit repo response and learning-loop state; do not infer adoption from mail absence, and do not let Rust structural checks satisfy DAD policy gates.

recent_changes.summary: Added a generated review-only packet and navigation route for the four open Phase 8 human gates; Phase 8 now declares awaiting_human_gate while command evidence remains pending human review.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use the packet to review Phase 8 gates, but do not treat it as approval or write roadmap/gate-evidence.json without explicit human review.

recent_changes.summary: Added first-class navigation and schema coverage for Rust rollout lesson capture so repo feedback during Rust mail storms is structured, append-only, and validation-backed.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use the Rust lesson-capture protocol and schema before sending or accepting Rust rollout feedback; run lessons-summarize after ledger appends.

recent_changes.summary: Added a dedicated runbook and navigation route for separating true dirty mail spools from ordinary dirty worktrees and Rust rollout reference-snapshot churn during concurrent repo mail storms.
recent_changes.agent_action: Run mail doctor with --repo all during multi-repo storms; use safe_to_collect/safe_to_route/safe_to_deliver for mail and --fail-on-worktree-dirty only when a clean git tree is required.

recent_changes.summary: Added a local deployment route for bootstrap, user hub locator, stable asset-dir shims, deployment-scope doctor, and unavailable-hub policy.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use this route before assuming DAD is callable from non-DAD repos; deployment readiness is separate from full operational readiness.

recent_changes.summary: Added non-enforced lesson lifecycle design so DAD can later review lessons for upgrade, downgrade, improvement, supersession, archive, and next-review cadence.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use this branch when an old lesson might be stale, noisy, harmful, superseded, or ready for promotion review; keep raw lessons immutable.

recent_changes.summary: Added Claude-readable root-cause packet guidance for integration and implementation patterns that may be architectural.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use this route when repeated failures suggest boundary, sequencing, ownership, contract, generated-evidence, or harness/enforcement root causes.

recent_changes.summary: Added DAD's harness-first decision model so agents avoid turning every useful pattern into bulky deterministic enforcement.
recent_changes.agent_action: Consult this model before promoting a finding to a hard check; use harnesses and subharnesses for learning-heavy or noisy issues.

recent_changes.summary: Added compact version/date navigation freshness so agents can detect rapid DAD changes without making the TOC deep or bulky.
recent_changes.agent_action: Start at AI_FRONT_DOOR.md, compare navigation_version and updated_at, then inspect affected branch_map rows instead of relying on memory.

recent_changes.summary: Added DAD's 9-layer address model and source-inspired layer 9 handling for compact learning and workflow coordinates.
recent_changes.agent_action: Read the address model branch when designing repo-local assets, exception records, workflow cards, or learning-loop coordinates.

recent_changes.summary: Added a repo-local digital asset memory standard so repos can log their own assets and DAD can collect metadata-only sightings.
recent_changes.agent_action: Use this branch before enrolling or comparing repo-local `.digital-asset/assets/` directories.

authority_boundary: This registry only governs DAD navigation freshness and routing. It does not make generated reports source truth, authorize downstream repo writes, or override source-repository authority.
